Tue after 4 PM.interpretation: The TA is unavailable on Tuesdays from 16:00 (4:00 PM) until the end of the day.

None.interpretation: No scheduling constraints; the TA is available at any time.

No Friday.interpretation: The TA is unavailable all day on Fridays (cannot work any time on Friday).

Mon/Wed only.interpretation: The TA is available to work only on Mondays and Wednesdays and unavailable all other days.

After 11 AM.interpretation: The TA is unavailable for any shift that starts at or after 11:00 on any day (i.e., they cannot work any time after 11:00).

No mornings.interpretation: The TA is unavailable to work any time before 12:00 (morning) on every day.
